name: Peacock
desc: A front-facing peacock raising a parametric train of iridescent eyespot feathers from closed to full fan, quivering and shimmering on the treble while it struts and bobs its crested head.

scale.doc: size vs design (fan spans ~0.85x min dim at full)

fan.doc: train opening: 0 closed/trailing, 1 full display fan

hue.doc: jewel base hue (210 = peacock sapphire; rotates whole jewel set)

pose.doc: pose preset; auto = section-driven medley per act

style.doc: aesthetic: art-nouveau jewel gradients & gold line / leaded stained-glass / oil-slick iridescent shift / monochrome stipple-hatch engraving

act.doc: multi-minute pose dramaturgy used when pose=auto
